ordered_branches.explanation: Globally normalizes fixed placeholder strings to NULL, defaults max fill100/topoff33/numeric user fields0, and deletes rows with NULL or zero maximum quantity. Warehouse argument restricts only some location duplicate/existing-capacity checks; most checks and all cleanup/staging writes are global. First location-duplicate warning does not set validation failure; grouped type-duplicate count can retain stale @iRecordsAffected if no rows. Checks location-type versus warehouse/location exclusivity, existing capacity, known location type, item/company and quantity UM using concatenated keys/NOT IN. Missing item/company rows are tagged in process/user stamps without setting failure; other failures return after cleanup. On success deletes all Staging_ILC rows and copies all Conversion_ILC rows, not only requested warehouse, then fills missing stamps. Printed records-to-process uses a different stale variable.
